Remark
[Pressure and the soliton potential] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0098 1. ch29:29.7\group Pressure Estimates

The identities $\Delta _g\log v=R-2v$ and $g=e^{-\log v}g_{S^2}$ make $\log v$ analogous to a steady-soliton potential.
